Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class AuthService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.AuthService
public class AuthService extends Object
Authentication and account-management service backed by the MySQL users table.

Handles login with role and active-account checks, Argon2id password hashing plus legacy-hash upgrade, registration, profile updates, and permanent buyer/seller deletion through UserRepository. The stored account is re-checked before sensitive actions.

  • Method Details

    • authenticate

      public User authenticate(String username, String password, UserRole role) throws SQLException
      Authenticates a user and returns the resolved account.

      This is a convenience wrapper around login(String, String, UserRole) that discards the classified failure reason. Callers that need to distinguish unknown users, wrong roles, deactivated accounts, and bad passwords should call login directly.

      Parameters:
      username - the submitted username; surrounding whitespace is ignored and the value is matched case-insensitively
      password - the submitted plaintext password
      role - the portal role required for the account
      Returns:
      the authenticated account, or null when authentication fails for any reason
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the account lookup or a legacy-password upgrade fails

    • login

      public AuthService.LoginResult login(String username, String password, UserRole role) throws SQLException
      Authenticates an account once and classifies the outcome.

      Inputs are rejected before any database work when the username is blank, the password is empty or longer than PasswordHasher.MAX_PASSWORD_LENGTH, or the role is null. A stored Argon2id hash is verified with PasswordHasher.verify(String, String). A legacy plaintext value is compared exactly and, on success, transparently re-hashed and replaced with a compare-and-set update; if another writer changes the stored password concurrently, the attempt fails with AuthService.LoginStatus.ACCOUNT_CHANGED instead of overwriting it.

      Parameters:
      username - the submitted username; surrounding whitespace is ignored and the value is matched case-insensitively
      password - the submitted plaintext password
      role - the portal role required for the account
      Returns:
      the classified outcome; only a AuthService.LoginStatus.SUCCESS result carries a user
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the account lookup or a legacy-password upgrade fails

    • deleteUserAsAdmin

      public void deleteUserAsAdmin(User admin, String username) throws SQLException
      Permanently deletes a buyer or seller account on behalf of an administrator.

      The caller's account is re-read from the database and must have the UserRole.ADMIN role. The account's active flag is not re-checked on this path. The target is validated by UserRepository.deleteUser(String), which also refuses admin accounts and performs the whole deletion in one transaction (seller listings removed, open deals cancelled, notifications deleted).

      Parameters:
      admin - the administrator performing the deletion; its stored role is checked
      username - the buyer or seller account to delete
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if admin is missing or not an admin, or if the target username is missing, unknown, or an admin account
      SQLException - if the deletion transaction fails; all changes are rolled back

    • register

      public void register(User user, String password) throws SQLException
      Registers a new account after validating and hashing its password.

      The username is trimmed and lower-cased before it is stored, and the password is hashed with Argon2id. All other fields are persisted as supplied.

      Parameters:
      user - the account to create; its username, role, and remaining fields must be populated
      password - the new plaintext password
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the password does not satisfy requireStrongPassword(String), or if the repository rejects a duplicate username or other invalid account data
      NullPointerException - if user or its username is null
      SQLException - if the insert fails

    • updateProfile

      public boolean updateProfile(User profile, String newPassword) throws SQLException
      Updates profile fields and, when supplied, the account password.

      The profile fields and the optional password hash are written in one database update. A non-empty new password must satisfy requireStrongPassword(String) and is hashed with Argon2id before it is sent to the repository.

      Parameters:
      profile - the profile values to save; the username identifies the account
      newPassword - a new plaintext password, or null/empty to keep the current password
      Returns:
      true when the account row was updated, false when no account matched the username or the write changed no values
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a new password is supplied but does not meet the strength rules
      SQLException - if the update fails

    • migrateLegacyPasswords

      public int migrateLegacyPasswords() throws SQLException
      Upgrades stored legacy plaintext passwords to Argon2id hashes.

      Idempotent: accounts that already hold an Argon2id hash are skipped, and each successful upgrade preserves the account's current password. The compare-and-set replacement means a concurrent password change is never overwritten by a stale migration.

      Returns:
      the number of accounts upgraded during this run
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the account listing or any upgrade fails
